scenario: dsc.rete does not lower a `fact::Json` cast (it has no defined shape), so dsc.driver refuses the rule with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_NOT_LOWERED (RLOW.1.6) instead of writing an artefact without it. Pin: `body: a::Json` in a call action, on the schema-typed fact bound to `a` ([LEXP.9.4.1]), is refused with that code.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Int mutable

service ext.api:
    kwarg body: Json
    no response

rule r:
    Event a
->
    call ext.api body: a::Json nocooldown
